description: Uncut 11.5 s lap of the 'Welcome!' track (country.tmx) of Pixel Wheels, recorded from the desktop build at 1920x1080 / 30 fps with all injected defects present: a single red car carrying a picked-up rocket waits through the countdown, races around the lap, slows down on the bottom straight, drives under the wooden footbridge, fires the rocket, which hits the fence and explodes, then turns north towards the start line.
reproduces: https://github.com/agateau/pixelwheels/issues/362 (Welcome! track: 'Footbridge over the road', rocket carried on the vehicle drawn over map elements) plus the injected rocket-orientation, rocket-exhaust, shadow-rotation, vehicle-shadow and camera look-ahead defects
scenario: Headless capture (Xvfb + software GL, frames read back from the GL back buffer, fixed 1/30 s steps) of a one-racer quick race on 'Welcome!' with the 'red' car: a rocket bonus is given to the car during the countdown, the game's own AI drives the lap, the car is then braked and coasted under the footbridge (bottom straight, x~52), the rocket is fired at x~45 and the AI takes over again for the corner back to the start line. Timestamps: 0-1.5 s countdown (zoomed-in car: crooked rocket, car shadow), 1.5-7 s lap (top straight eastbound, south side, bottom straight westbound), 9.3-9.5 s car under the footbridge, 9.9-10.2 s rocket fired, exhaust and explosion at the fence, 10.5-11.5 s car heading north.
